atAGlance: Ghẹ hấp bia is blue swimmer crab steamed with beer, usually with lemongrass, ginger, salt-pepper-lime dip, and sweet crab meat.
whatItIs: Ghẹ hấp bia is blue crab steamed with beer, lemongrass, and light aromatics so the crab stays clean and sweet.
howToEnjoy: Crack the shells and taste the crab before adding much dipping salt. The beer steam should make the crab smell clean, not boozy.
howLocalsOrder: Order ghẹ hấp bia as a shared seafood plate. Ask about size, shells, and dipping salt before the crab arrives.
worthKnowing: Ghẹ is blue swimmer crab; steaming with beer and lemongrass is a Vietnamese seafood-shop way to keep it sweet and aromatic.
